entities.summary: Renuka Kesaramadu is a contemporary painter and sculptor from India. She is best known internationally through her collaborative art exhibitions and participations in workshops in Europe. She has also curated a few international art symposia and exhibitions in India. Renuka Kesaramadu was a painters & sculptors from Tumkur (b. 1957, Tumkur). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
